scope: The historic Mermaid Inn ranges and entry courtyard on Mermaid Street, Rye, as represented in 2019, including the black-and-white timber elevations, pitched roofs, brick stacks and rear passage.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The heritage listing describes half-timbered ranges, their inner courtyard and passage, tiled roofs, gables and projecting first floor.
The inn identifies its historic frontage and position on sloping Mermaid Street.
The survey identifies the eastern lodging range and inner courtyard.
